title: All of It, Always, from Now On.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(The final run of summer training
camp...! 
Time to show the results...
of working hand-in-hand with Trainer!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Trainer, thank you so much!
choice_data_list: Congratulations on completing ever...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! ...And that's a wrap.
Summer training camp really flew by in the
blink of an eye, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, all we did was run and run.
Nothing but running.
I guess that's youth for you!
choice_data_list: Well, do you want to do something ...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Can we?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, yes...! Let's do it!
Hold on, I'll go look up some events!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
look! There's a fireworks festival.
Doesn't that sound super summery?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...We used to go watch them together back then,
remember?
Mom dressed us up in yukata,
and we went up a tall building...
choice_data_list: Yeah, I remember. If I recall—

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Waah...! So pretty!
Ehehe, tamayaaa!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Big Bro, which fireworks do you like best?
Bu-chan loves the gold ones!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis, which fireworks do you like best?
Bu-chan loves the gold ones!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
I wanna see them up close...! 'Cause then,
it looks like they're softly raining down
from above, right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Those were the days.
Do you think we can see them even closer
this time?
choice_data_list: In that case, I'll find us the per...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Really?
Hehe, I can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Alright, so our meet-up time is—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Did I get here too early?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Still...
you actually remembered watching fireworks
together back then.
...Ehehe.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(I guess it's been since that day.
I wonder if
Trainer's eyes still sparkle even as a
grown-up? Hehe.)
choice_data_list: Buena, sorry to keep you waiting!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...! Oh no, I just got here myself!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, let's go.
Whereabouts are we heading?
choice_data_list: Right this way!
Right this way!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Wait, what?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Whaaat...?!?
choice_data_list: What's wrong, Buena?
What's wrong, Buena?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean, 'what's wrong'...?!
I mean, we're on a ship... Or rather,
we're out on the open sea?!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You said we were going to watch
fireworks...
...Did you book a cruise ship...?!
choice_data_list: It popped up when I looked around,...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: 'Couldn't resist'?! That's...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Pfft... ahahaha...!
Honestly...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...I never could have imagined...
A cruise ship, of all things.
choice_data_list: This is where we can see the firew...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...You've really learned how to pull off
surprises like this without batting an eye,
haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Grown-ups really are... amazing.
You just keep getting cooler and cooler.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...You've really changed, haven't you?
So much since we were kids.
choice_data_list: If I have, it's all thanks to you,...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks to me...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(You said it so casually,
in such a nonchalant tone.
Uttering something so incredible as if it
were the most natural thing in the world.)
choice_data_list: Just being a childhood friend wasn...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(A faint,
self-deprecating bitterness flickered across
your face as you muttered those words.)
choice_data_list: I gave it my all because I knew I ...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(The gaze looking straight at me is as gentle
as it was back then—
—and yet, so much stronger now.)
choice_data_list: So if I've changed, it's all becau...
So if I've changed, it's all becau...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“I can push myself to the ends of the earth
for Buena.
I can grow as much as it takes—
it's as simple as that.”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Big Bro.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Big Sis.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Big Bro...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Big Sis...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That's not fair.
No matter how hard I chase after you...
it's never enough.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Because you just keep showing me new sides
of yourself.
choice_data_list: ...Does that make you feel lonely ...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all.
Right now... I'm just so happy,
I can barely contain it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Getting to know you,
and wanting to know more about you...
makes me so happy.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hey, the parts of you that never change,
Big Bro,
and the parts of you that do...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hey, the parts of you that never change,
Big Sis,
and the parts of you that do...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Can I stay right beside you...
in the closest spot of all...
and keep watching over all of it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Because I want to know everything about you,
from here on out too...!
choice_data_list: ...Of course!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(The fireworks launched into the night
sky.
Blooming into grand,
brilliant blossoms far larger than anything
we saw that day.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Shoulder to shoulder with you,
I burned this dreamlike panorama into my
memory.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look! It's the gold ones...! 
...Amazing.
They're raining down like sparkling
light...
choice_data_list: It looks like golden rain.
It looks like golden rain.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it really does... *sniff*.
Huh? Why am I... ugh...! *sniffle*
choice_data_list: Did you get a little too overwhelm...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
B-But... because...!
It's just so, so beautiful...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I wonder why?
It's even more beautiful than when we were
kids...

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Big Bro, which fireworks do you like best?
Bu-chan loves the gold ones!

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis, which fireworks do you like best?
Bu-chan loves the gold ones!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(...Back then,
I was only staring up at the fireworks.
I never noticed what that golden light was
shining down upon.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Ah, I see now.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: It's so... beautiful.
